authored_narrative.episode_purpose: The isolation Episode 2 first named returns here not as a threat but as a memory Gonagi can finally sit with — the train-memory anchor recognized on sight rather than endured for the first time.

scene_spirited_away_train_memory_0024.purpose: The same open, unpeopled quality that once read as loneliness (Episode 2) now reads as stillness — Gonagi's posture toward solitude has changed even though the space hasn't.
scene_spirited_away_train_memory_0024.stakes: whether solitude can be revisited without reopening the isolation it once meant
scene_spirited_away_train_memory_0024.opposing_force: the memory itself, which does not know it has been outgrown and offers no cue that this time is different

scene_spirited_away_bathhouse_arrival_00.purpose: A last bathhouse-shaped space closes the loop begun in Episode 1 — not a fourth threshold to cross, but confirmation that the crossing itself is long since finished.
scene_spirited_away_bathhouse_arrival_00.stakes: whether the story needs a fifth episode after this, or whether this is where the arc actually completes
scene_spirited_away_bathhouse_arrival_00.opposing_force: the shape of the space itself, built to suggest a threshold, even now that it isn't functioning as one

shot_spirited_00185.intent: A static, held frame with no camera movement at all — the first time in this Story stillness is trusted to carry a beat on its own.

shot_spirited_00193.intent: A final wide echo of shot 00001 and shot 00097 — the same composition, a third time, now read as a closing bracket rather than a repeated motif.
